wrapper:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
TC=/home/charles/code/friends/.toolchains
export OPAMROOT="$TC/opam"
unset OPAMSWITCH OPAM_SWITCH_PREFIX OCAMLPATH OCAMLLIB CAML_LD_LIBRARY_PATH COQPATH ROCQPATH
export PATH="$TC/bin:$TC/native/bin:$PATH"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$TC/native/lib/pkgconfig${PKG_CONFIG_PATH:+:$PKG_CONFIG_PATH}"
export C_INCLUDE_PATH="$TC/native/include${C_INCLUDE_PATH:+:$C_INCLUDE_PATH}"
export LIBRARY_PATH="$TC/native/lib${LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LIBRARY_PATH}"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$TC/native/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
if (( $# == 0 )); then set -- /bin/bash --noprofile --norc; fi
exec "$TC/bin/opam" exec --switch=picinae --set-switch -- "$@"
